semiconductor_relevance: High — The company specializes in semiconductor equipment development, design, manufacturing, and sales, serving major semiconductor manufacturers globally.
summary: Creative Technology (Shanghai) Co., Ltd is a key player in the semiconductor equipment sector, focusing on the development, design, manufacturing, and sales of equipment used in material processing, surface treatment, and bonding evaluation and testing. Established in 2005, the company is known for its high-precision research and development and comprehensive quality control, catering to major semiconductor manufacturers worldwide.
